Container.Name: dungeonmind
Container.Overview:
DungeonMind: play D&D 5e (SRD 5.1 and 5.2) together in the browser with an AI Dungeon Master.
The AI makes the adventure, narrates, gives every player four choices plus "Other", and hands out XP. The server owns every number: dice, hit points, spell slots and feature uses are tracked every turn by the Bookkeeper. Character builder, AI-made sheets, campaign file, initiative, zone board, rerolls with voting, a built-in CPU narrator voice (Kokoro), portraits and 3D dice.
All AI runs through your own HiveMind (github.com/turkushan490/hivemind): DungeonMind installs its canvases there with one click. One container, CPU only, everything in /data (SQLite).
ADULTS ONLY (18+): the stories are dark and mature. Every user confirms their age once.
Container.Requires: A HiveMind instance (github.com/turkushan490/hivemind, with the DungeonMind API changes) and a HiveMind API token. HiveMind in turn needs Ollama or a cloud AI; ComfyUI is optional for portraits and scene images. For adults (18+) only.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: dnd d&d dungeons dragons rpg tabletop 5e srd ai dungeon master hivemind ollama tts kokoro

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (games, characters, campaign files), images, cached narrator audio and voice models. Back this up.

Config.Name: HiveMind URL
Config.Description: Your HiveMind, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4820 (LAN IP, not localhost). Used on the first start; change it later in Settings.

Config.Name: HiveMind token
Config.Description: A HiveMind API token (hm_...) from HiveMind Settings, API tokens. Use a member account, not a viewer.

Config.Name: Auth mode
Config.Description: login: DungeonMind login page (username + password, friends register themselves). portal: Auth portal (e.g. turkushan-auth) + admin login (people come in through the portal; the login page is only for the Docker admin).

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: The admin account. It is created on every start if it is missing, and made admin with the password below if it exists.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account, set on every start. At least 5 characters, with 1 capital and 1 symbol.
